plain: A long, loud, forceful speech that lectures the listeners

webster.text: A speech addressed to an assembly or an army; a popular oration; a public address.

more.text: Declamation; a noisy, pompous or irregular address.
To address by oration; as, the general harangued the troops.

example.quote: But, as the honorable gentleman considers his harangue as containing some reasoning, I shall take notice of a few remarks.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, July 2, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
